subject: gate.sh --full parallel: adapter-unittest.py full and verify.py --result shard per module / case file across tests.parallel processes (process count decided at run time from cgroup CPU quota and free memory / measured per-process peak, D-074; tests.parallel = cap only; 1 = today), merged schema-1 result.json, tests.unittest.serial list, shared-state audit, measured speedup
objective: D-073 background: the land full suite runs single-process, 27-47 min in the cloud (#161's green land: gate 1595 s = unit layer ≈ 1150 s + regression layer 298 cases 442 s, reports/t161/20261024-232309-12038-gate); D-073 lists '全套平行跑 (預估 27 → 約 10 分鐘,未實測)' as to-open. Container has 4 CPUs. (1) scripts/adapter-unittest.py 'full' runs the discovered modules in N worker processes: one subprocess per module ('python3 adapter-unittest.py run <module>' with its own AC_TEST_OUT=<out>/shard-<k>/), at most N at once, N decided at run time per D-074 (see A4: cgroup CPU quota and cgroup/meminfo free memory divided by the measured per-process peak, one core left for the system, memory short -> 1; board/config.json tests.parallel only caps N; tests.parallel=1 = today's single in-process run byte for byte), longest-known-module first (a per-module seconds file under reports_dir/test-times.json written after every full run; absent = discovery order), then merges the shards into one result.json (schema 1: ids union, seconds = wall, environment_suspect concatenated, rc = worst per §4: any 86 -> 86 else any fail/error -> 1 else 0; a shard that exits without a valid result.json -> rc 2 and the module named) and one log (shard logs concatenated in module order with a header line per shard). (2) scripts/verify.py --result (the built-in 'regression') shards per case file the same way, same key; the same-round cache (AC_TICKET + AC_RUN_ID + sha) is unchanged and still stores/hits the merged result. (3) tests.unittest.serial: [modules] run one at a time after the parallel phase (for a module whose shared state cannot be isolated); a name not discovered -> warning line, not an error. (4) Shared-state audit written in EVIDENCE: for every tests/ module and verify/ case file, what it writes outside its own sandbox/tempdir (repo-root gate.log / verify.log, reports/, board/events.jsonl, fixed ports, fixed /tmp names, os.chdir) and how it is isolated; a red that appears only when parallel is an isolation bug to fix, never marked flaky. Known: tests/test_verify_runner.py uses os.chdir (fine per-process); test_board binds port 0; control_harness sandboxes write events under the sandbox. (5) Measurement in EVIDENCE: per-process peak RSS (sets PER_PROCESS_PEAK_MIB), unit layer and regression layer wall at tests.parallel=1 and at the run-time N in this container (one run each, load noted), speedup, and the slowest module (critical path; role-procedures records test_auto_fix ≈ 270 s alone). Not here: gate.sh --branch changes (next ticket), splitting test_auto_fix into smaller modules (open a ticket if it is the critical path), the project side (T) - a project's own 'full' command is its business, the built-in adapter is A's.
acceptance: A1 sharding + serial list (tests/test_adapter_unittest.py, fixture roots written by the test: three modules, each sleeping 2 s in one test and holding 2 more trivial tests; AC_CGROUP_ROOT points at a fake cgroup dir with cpu.max '400000 100000' and memory.max/memory.current leaving 100 x PER_PROCESS_PEAK_MIB, so the run-time N is not the limiter): AC_TEST_OUT=<out> 'adapter-unittest.py full' with tests.parallel=3 -> wall < 4.5 s, result.json has 9 rows, every id present once with the status the module declares, <out>/shard-*/result.json count == 3, the merged 'log' contains three 'Ran ' lines, log header order follows a hand-written reports_dir/test-times.json (descending seconds); tests.parallel=1 -> the same id/status set, wall >= 6 s, no shard-* dir (today's path). tests.unittest.serial ['test_c'] with modules a,b,c -> c's start timestamp > max(end timestamps of a and b) (modules append start/end to a file the test reads); a serial name not discovered -> one stdout line containing 'serial' and the name, rc unaffected.

A2 rc merge + config (same file): one module with a failing test -> full rc 1 and that id's row is 'fail' while the other modules' rows are 'pass'; one module that prints an 'ENVIRONMENT-SUSPECT:' declared row -> full rc 86, merged environment_suspect has exactly that row (seven keys), other rows still present; a module file with a syntax error -> an 'error' row under that module id, rc 1; a shard whose process exits 0 without writing result.json (fixture module that deletes its own AC_TEST_OUT in tearDownModule) -> rc 2 and stdout names the module and 'result.json'. tests.parallel=0 or 'x' -> rc 2 naming 'tests.parallel'; project_config.py check on a config carrying tests.parallel and tests.unittest.serial -> rc 0, no unknown-key warning (schema table gains both keys). Mutation (not measured by opener): m1 merge takes the first shard's rc -> first arm red.

A3 regression layer (tests/test_verify_runner.py, sandbox verify/ with four case files under two tags, same fake AC_CGROUP_ROOT as A1): 'verify.py --result <out>/result.json' with tests.parallel=2 -> one result.json with every case id, same id set as tests.parallel=1, stdout has exactly one 'parallel: ' line; with AC_TICKET/AC_RUN_ID set the second call hits the cache (existing cache cases green, the cached result copied back); '--case <one file>' runs only that file (unchanged); '--tag' selection unchanged. A case file that fails -> rc 1 and its row.

A4 run-time process count (D-074 item 2; tests/test_adapter_unittest.py, all inputs from fake files: AC_CGROUP_ROOT=<tmp>/cg holding cpu.max / memory.max / memory.current, AC_MEMINFO=<tmp>/meminfo; P = adapter's PER_PROCESS_PEAK_MIB constant; no real memory is allocated). Rule: cores = min(floor(quota/period), os.cpu_count()) when cpu.max is numeric, else os.cpu_count(); free = memory.max - memory.current when memory.max is numeric, else MemAvailable; N = min(max(1, cores - 1), floor(free / P)), N < 1 -> 1; tests.parallel, when set, gives min(N, tests.parallel) and never raises N. Every 'full' (and 'verify.py --result') run prints exactly one line 'parallel: N processes (cores X, available memory Y MiB, per-process Z MiB)' plus '; capped by tests.parallel=P' when the cap lowered N and '; memory short, fallback 1' when memory gave < 1, also visible in 'gate.sh --full' output. Cases (expected N computed by the test from the fixture numbers, never from the adapter): (a) cpu.max '400000 100000', free 10P -> N 3, line 'cores 4' (skip if os.cpu_count() < 4); (b) cpu.max 'max 100000', memory.max 'max', meminfo MemAvailable 2.5P (kB) -> N == min(max(1, os.cpu_count()-1), 2); (c) free 0.5P -> N 1 and 'memory short, fallback 1'; (d) empty AC_CGROUP_ROOT and meminfo -> falls back to os.cpu_count() and MemAvailable; (e) cores 4, free 10P, tests.parallel=2 -> N 2 with 'capped by tests.parallel=2'; tests.parallel=8 -> N 3, no 'capped'. N is observed both in the line and as the max count of overlapping start/end intervals of 5 sleeping fixture modules (<= N).

A5 dogfood measurement (EVIDENCE, worker, in its worktree, AC_ROOT the worktree): per-process peak RSS measured per shard (resource.getrusage RUSAGE_CHILDREN ru_maxrss or /usr/bin/time -v) over one full parallel run - table of the top 5 modules and the max; PER_PROCESS_PEAK_MIB = that max rounded up with stated margin, value and source cited in a code comment. Then 'sh scripts/gate.sh --full' once at the run-time N (tests.parallel unset; paste its 'parallel: ' line) and once with tests.parallel=1 (the 1595 s cloud figure from #161 may be cited as a second baseline); table: unit wall, regression wall, total, speedup, slowest module and its seconds, 'uptime' before each run; the parallel run is green or every red is explained as an isolation bug and fixed in the same ticket (never flaky-marked). reports/test-times.json exists after the run and the second run orders shards by it.

verify.notes: #169 cases are the classes AdapterParallelCases (tests/test_adapter_cases.py: A1, A2, A4, test-plan shared-state arm) and ParallelRegressionCases (tests/test_verify_runner.py: A3). Fixture modules, a fake cgroup v2 dir (cpu.max, memory.max, memory.current in bytes) and a fake meminfo are written under a tempdir; AC_CGROUP_ROOT / AC_MEMINFO point at them; nothing under /sys is touched and no memory is allocated. Expected N is arithmetic in the test (_expected_n) from the fixture numbers; PER_PROCESS_PEAK_MIB is read from the adapter only to size them. A1 parallel arm, A1 serial arm, A4(a) and A4(e) skip when os.cpu_count() < 4. Timing: A1 asserts wall < 4.5 s (parallel=3) and >= 6 s (parallel=1) over 2 s sleeps; the class takes ~40-60 s. Every 'parallel: ' line is read from stdout, as are the serial-not-discovered warning and the missing-result.json message (the acceptance says stdout).

red_lines: tests.test_adapter_cases.AdapterParallelCases.test_shared_state_red_is_not_hidden_under_parallel: AssertionError: False is not true : adapter-unittest.py has no PER_PROCESS_PEAK_MIB

test_plan: Layers: unit (tests/test_adapter_unittest.py, tests/test_verify_runner.py) with fixture modules written by the test under a temp root - timings asserted with generous margins (sleep 2 s per module; < 4.5 s parallel vs >= 6 s serial); rc and row assertions use the fixture's own declared statuses as oracle, never the adapter's output. Worker, foreground: timeout 590 python3 -m unittest tests.test_adapter_unittest tests.test_verify_runner; then tests.test_gate tests.test_status (gate reads the merged result); then the A5 measurement. Verifier (needs_verifier true, interface_fixed true: config keys, schema-1 result fields and the §4 rc table are pinned here) writes tests/test_adapter_parallel_cases.py in parallel: two fixture modules that both write a fixed path under the temp root -> under parallel=2 at least one shows a fail/error row (the runner must not hide shared-state reds); the merged log contains every shard's 'Ran ' line; a shard timeout (fixture module sleeping past tests.timeout_seconds.full = 2) -> rc 2 within 30 s wall and stdout contains 'timeout' (unmeasured, never red). Run-time N (A4) fixture: the test writes a fake cgroup v2 dir under its tempdir (cpu.max, memory.max, memory.current as plain text; bytes) and a fake meminfo ('MemAvailable: <kB> kB'), points AC_CGROUP_ROOT / AC_MEMINFO at them, and reads P from the adapter module only as an input to size the numbers; expected N is arithmetic in the test from the fixture values, never the adapter's output. Reproducible as uid 0 in this container (plain files in a tempdir; nothing under /sys is written; no memory is actually consumed); case (a) skips when os.cpu_count() < 4. Mutations (not measured by opener): m1 as A2; m2 serial list ignored -> A1 serial arm red; m3 cache key omits the merged result -> A3 cache arm red; m4 parallel ignores the cap -> A4(e) red; m5 N ignores memory -> A4(c) red; m6 no core left for the system -> A4(a) red; m7 tests.parallel raises N -> A4(e) second arm red. Shared-state audit is EVIDENCE text with one line per module. Container is uid 0; hard_block.patterns forbids os.kill / killpg / pkill / 'kill -' in added tests/** lines - stopping a shard on timeout is subprocess.run(timeout=) inside scripts/, never a test line; set PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 in shards or accept CPython's atomic .pyc rename (state which in EVIDENCE).
outline: D-073 to-open item '全套平行跑'. Facts: #161 land gate 1595 s (unit ≈ 1150 s + verify-b2a3e360f66e.log 'Ran 298 tests in 442.346s'); 42 test modules / 1256 unit tests; 22 verify case files / 326 case methods; adapter-unittest.py run_suite 327-349 is one in-process TextTestRunner (RecordingResult, LogStream, EnvironmentResult threshold) - keep it as the per-shard runner; write_result 384 is the single result.json writer (reuse for the merge); verify.py --result runs through the adapter's run_suite in-process (header lines 35-41). Shared state found by grep: os.chdir only in tests/test_verify_runner.py; port 0 in test_board; 12 modules use tempfile, the rest use control_harness.Sandbox (tempdir); gate tests set AC_GATE_LOG. Not measured by opener: per-module wall distribution (a background full run would have loaded the #160 gate running in this container); the speedup (D-073's 27 → 10 min is an estimate). D-074 item 2: N decided at run time (A4); tests.parallel is a cap only. Measured by opener: this container is cgroup v1 hybrid - no /sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.max or memory.max (cpu.cfs_quota_us -1, memory.limit_in_bytes unlimited), so here the rule takes the os.cpu_count()=4 / MemAvailable ≈ 14.9 GiB fallback -> expect N 3 unless P > ~5 GiB; cgroup v1 file support is not in this ticket. Per-process peak P is the worker's measurement (A5), not guessed. Interface pinned: AC_CGROUP_ROOT (default /sys/fs/cgroup), AC_MEMINFO (default /proc/meminfo), PER_PROCESS_PEAK_MIB, the 'parallel: ' line, tests.parallel (int >= 1, cap), tests.unittest.serial (list), result.json schema 1 unchanged, reports/test-times.json {module: seconds}. complex (two runners + merge + measurement). Depends on #162 (gate/full go through testiface and the adapter) and #163 (verify-case runs regression --case through verify.py --result; land after it so the sharding lands on the rewired classification). needs_verifier true, interface_fixed true. Order: before the branch-gate-regression ticket (it relies on this speedup).
